items.sentence_en: Could I please talk to Mr. Jackson?

items.phonetic: kʊd aɪ pliz tɔk tɪ ˈmɪstər. ˈʤæksən?

items.sentence_en: I could make things easier for you.
items.sentence_vi: Tôi có thể làm cho mọi thứ dễ dàng hơn cho bạn.

items.sentence_en: I could sure use that reward money.

items.phonetic: tɑm sɛd hi wɑz ˌɛnˈʤɔɪɪŋ ðə ˈpɑrti.

items.sentence_en: I suggest you have a talk with Tom.
